summary: Implementation plan for updating the Japanese Language Course enrollment flow with natural Benglish/Bengali labels ("এখনই এনরোল করুন" and "আবেদন করুন (আলোচনা সাপেক্ষে পেমেন্ট)"), adding a Full Payment (20% OFF) vs Installment Payment (50% Now) selector inside the Instant Enrollment tab, and polishing the end-to-end UX.
